full_name: Camilo Mendez | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Arts Rieman and Baketel Fellow for Music Independent Composer (United Kingdom)
bio: Camilo Mendez is a Colombian composer based in the United Kingdom since 2006. His work is characterized by the composition of musical cycles based on texts and extramusical stimuli.
